title: Plain HTML
description: A complete page without a build step: the CDN bundle, the design tokens, <minerva-config>, a validated form and event listeners. Import maps for the per-element modules.

page.title: A complete page
page.text: Two tags in the <head> are enough: the design tokens stylesheet and the self-contained module bundle (every element, Lit and minerva-design/core). Copy this file and open it in a browser:
page.tokens: tokens.css defines the design tokens (colors, spacing, radii, fonts) that the elements and your own CSS can use with var().
page.config: <minerva-config> with root applies the theme (here following the operating system), the palette and the language of the built-in texts to the whole document.
page.form: The controls are form-associated: name, required, the value / checked attributes, <label for>, type="submit" and type="reset" buttons, FormData and the browser's validation work as with native inputs. The submit event only fires once every control is valid.
page.events: minerva-* events bubble, so a single listener on the form (or on document) receives the changes of every control; event.target is the element and event.detail holds the new value.
page.modal: Setting a property from script (modal.open = true) never fires an event; the close button and Escape close the modal and fire minerva-open-change.

importMaps.title: Per-element modules with an import map
importMaps.text: The CDN bundle contains every element. To download only the elements a page uses, load the per-element modules of the package (dist/elements/<name>.js) instead. They are the files bundlers use, with bare imports of their dependencies, which an import map resolves in the browser:
importMaps.deps: The modules import lit (including lit/decorators.js and lit/directives/*, hence the "lit/" prefix), minerva-design/core (which itself depends on @floating-ui/dom), and, for the HTML preview and JSON field only, dompurify and jsonc-parser. esm.sh resolves the dependencies of those packages for you; when you host the files yourself, map @floating-ui/dom, @floating-ui/core and @floating-ui/utils as well.
importMaps.note: Use exact versions in production, and make sure every module loads the same copy of lit and minerva-design/core: mixing the CDN bundle with the per-element modules on one page downloads the shared code twice, and each tag keeps the first definition that registered it.
